title: Hybrid Solar Cells with Perovskite Materials for Sustainable Energy
title_english: (Hybrid Solar Cells with Perovskite Materials for Sustainable Energy)
abstract: This study investigates hybrid solar cell performance using perovskite materials. The research demonstrates significant improvements in energy conversion efficiency through optimized material composition.
acknowledgements: The authors thank the Ministry of Education for research grant support.

content.text: Renewable energy research has gained significant momentum in recent years [1]. Previous studies have demonstrated the potential of hybrid photovoltaic systems [2] for improving energy conversion efficiency. Table I summarizes key material parameters while Table II compares electrical characteristics.

content.Title: Material parameters for hybrid solar cells

content.text: The experimental setup followed standard protocols [3] for photovoltaic characterization. Solar simulator measurements were conducted under AM1.5G illumination.
This study confirms that perovskite-based hybrid solar cells offer superior performance [4]. Future work should focus on stability improvements.
